comparison_class.compute_accounting: Candidate fits 15 clean ancestor/teacher nodes per fold plus three final models per cell (60 fold-graph fits + 90 final-member fits for the 30-cell candidate arm). Rank-1 deep has one fit per cell. Capture actual wall time, successful updates, memory, and export/CPU latency; no throughput or quality-per-compute claim is assumed.
comparison_class.interpretation: Bundle-level quality comparison against a single labels-only model.
comparison_class.matched_execution: For each paired cell, both arms must use the same provider/runtime and exact fold membership. If the frozen deep endpoint is not available on that same route, the cell is unmatched and must not enter the primary paired estimand.
comparison_class.teacher_variance: The fold-specific teacher and propensity graph uses fixed role seeds and is reused over that fold’s cell seeds; the 30-cell estimate therefore conditions on those ancestors and does not estimate teacher/propensity seed variability.

effect_screen.qualification: That addendum preceded the first rank-1 endpoint but this TL3 design is written later. This threshold is not a prospectively registered threshold for this design; root must either keep it only as an allocation heuristic or freeze a dated decision rule before candidate outcomes.
effect_screen.source: borrowed as a proposed screen from DECISION_ADDENDUM.json

cp30_design.exposure: All four folds, including F0, are historically exposed. This estimates robustness on an exposed panel, not untouched-holdout confirmation or a public-score effect.
cp30_design.full_fit_vs_cv: Public incumbent is a full train+valid fit including the former validation partitions; each proposed outer-fold candidate is fit-only and excludes that fold’s evaluation components through every learned ancestor. A fold score is not a public-fit estimate or exact submitted checkpoint.
cp30_design.metric_definition: global_wp_clip2_v1 with the official prescribed scoring mask, ±2 clipping and original clipped-label-magnitude weights; no evaluator or mask changes.
cp30_design.multiple_comparisons: Primary comparison is only versus rank-1 deep. Rank-1 wide remains unchanged and is not used to choose among TL3 variants. No public-score tuning, per-fold variant selection, member selection or blend fitting.
cp30_design.pair_reference: unchanged frozen E-RR18-01-LABELS deep endpoint; one candidate blend cell versus one deep cell for identical (fold, seed), same source-qualified evaluation groups and same provider/runtime.
cp30_design.primary_outcome: global_wp_clip2_v1 from the official evaluator on the exact fold evaluation groups; preserve component/t0/t1 fields.
cp30_design.primary_statistic: For each fold, average the paired seed-level candidate-minus-deep deltas; average those four fold means equally.
cp30_design.uncertainty: 10,000 paired bootstrap draws using shared seed identities jointly across arms with folds fixed, as specified by the active campaign authority; also retain per-cell whole-component conditional intervals. Component resampling is conditional on fixed models and does not measure training variability.

decision_and_falsifiers.alternative_explanation: Any gain may arise from three-model averaging, extra training compute, heterogeneous input channels, teacher distillation, optimization, or their interactions. This design cannot attribute it to one mechanism.
decision_and_falsifiers.contrary_observation: A negative mean, failed leakage/source gate, tiedlead parity failure, row misalignment, nonfinite run, or unverified/skipped updates blocks a positive quality conclusion. A CI crossing zero is inconclusive, not universal refutation.
decision_and_falsifiers.public_transfer: Unknown until an authorized external evaluation; do not add local deltas to the historical 0.66832 incumbent score or call this a public-score prediction.
decision_and_falsifiers.supporting_observation: A positive equal-fold paired mean that clears a separately frozen practical threshold and is stable across folds would support this whole three-member bundle for a further quality/cost review only.

estimand: Equal-weight mean across folds of the per-fold mean paired cell delta: fixed TL3-like three-member blend minus the frozen rank-1 deep H384x2 endpoint, conditional on one fixed clean teacher/propensity graph per fold. This is a whole-pipeline bundle comparison, not an isolated distillation, feature, optimizer, or teacher effect.

feature_contract.base: 211 causal channels: 112 raw plus 99 event features in canonical order.
feature_contract.tiedlead: 263 = the 211-channel base plus 52 lead channels; implement the exact shared lead semantics described below in a reviewed focused canonical adapter. No generic 263-wide GRU may be called equivalent.
feature_contract.transform_rules: Fit-only canonical two-batch normalization for scratch roots/students; exact clean parent buffers inherited for initialized fine-tunes/final distilled student. Hash the ordered normalization membership and saved buffers.

final_bundle.blend_operation: On exactly identical ordered eval rows, compute FP32 0.34*p_distilled + 0.33*p_tlead_A + 0.33*p_tlead_B in that order. Do not optimize, calibrate, or retune coefficients.
